# bootmlm

The `bootmlm` package does bootstrap resampling for multilevel models.
Currently only models fitted with
[`lme4::lmer()`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/lme4/man/lmer.html) is supported.
It’s still in developmental stage and is not yet on CRAN. However, you
can install the package on GitHub:

``` r

if (!require("remotes")) {
  install.packages("remotes")
}
remotes::install_github("marklhc/bootmlm")
```

See [this
paper](https://quantscience.rbind.io/files/Lai_2020_mbr_bootstrap_mlm_effectsize_am.pdf)
for a performance comparison of different bootstrapped confidence
intervals for multilevel effect size estimations:

Lai, M. H. C. (2020). Bootstrap confidence interval for multilevel
standardized effect size. *Multivariate Behavioral Research, 56*(4),
558–578. Advance online publication.
<https://doi.org/10.1080/00273171.2020.1746902>

## Example

Here is an example to get the bootstrap distributions of the fixed
effects and the level-1 error SD:

``` r

library(lme4)
fm01ML <- lmer(Yield ~ (1 | Batch), Dyestuff, REML = FALSE)
mySumm <- function(x) {
  c(getME(x, "beta"), sigma(x))
}
# Covariance preserving residual bootstrap
library(bootmlm)
boo01 <- bootstrap_mer(fm01ML, mySumm, type = "residual", nsim = 100)
# Plot bootstrap distribution of fixed effect
library(boot)
plot(boo01, index = 1)
# Get confidence interval
boot.ci(boo01, index = 2, type = c("norm", "basic", "perc"))
# BCa using influence values computed from `empinf_mer`
boot.ci(boo01, index = 2, type = "bca", L = empinf_mer(fm01ML, mySumm, 2))
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`bootstrap_mer()`](https://marklhc.github.io/bootmlm/reference/bootstrap_mer.md)
  : Run Various Bootstrap for Mixed Models.
- [`confint(`*`<boot>`*`)`](https://marklhc.github.io/bootmlm/reference/confint.boot.md)
  : Bootstrap confidence intervals for Two-Level Mixed Models
- [`devfun_mer()`](https://marklhc.github.io/bootmlm/reference/devfun_mer.md)
  [`devfun_mer2()`](https://marklhc.github.io/bootmlm/reference/devfun_mer.md)
  : Deviance Function for Multilevel Models
- [`empinf_mer()`](https://marklhc.github.io/bootmlm/reference/empinf_mer.md)
  [`empinf_merm()`](https://marklhc.github.io/bootmlm/reference/empinf_mer.md)
  : Empirical Influence Values for Two-Level Mixed Models
- [`pop_syn`](https://marklhc.github.io/bootmlm/reference/pop_syn.md) :
  Synthetic Pupil Popularity Dataset
- [`prof_ci_icc()`](https://marklhc.github.io/bootmlm/reference/prof_ci_icc.md)
  : Profile Likelihood Confidence Interval for Intraclass Correlation
- [`scores_mer()`](https://marklhc.github.io/bootmlm/reference/scores_mer.md)
  : Score Functions and Case-wise Derivatives
- [`solve_eigen_sqrt()`](https://marklhc.github.io/bootmlm/reference/solve_eigen_sqrt.md)
  : Get the square root of a matrix using eigenvalue decomposition, and
  solve for a linear system
- [`vcov_theta()`](https://marklhc.github.io/bootmlm/reference/vcov_theta.md)
  : Asymptotic Covariance Matrix for Cholesky Factor of Random Effects
- [`vcov_vc()`](https://marklhc.github.io/bootmlm/reference/vcov_vc.md)
  : Asymptotic Covariance Matrix for Random Effects
